front: What was the policy of reconciliation in 1980?
back: A policy of forgiving the past and including all races and parties in the new state, announced by Mugabe on 4 March 1980.
The agreement of 22 December 1987 that merged ZANU (PF) and PF-ZAPU into one party.

front: What happened at Entumbane in 1980 and 1981?
back: Clashes between ZIPRA and ZANLA units awaiting integration into the new army.
February 1982, after arms caches were found on PF-ZAPU properties.

What was the MDC and when was it formed?
back: The Movement for Democratic Change, formed in 1999 under Morgan Tsvangirai from unions and civic groups.

front: What were the results of the Unity Accord?
back: An end to the dissident conflict, an amnesty, a merged party, an executive presidency and a dominant-party system.

front: How should casualty numbers for the 1980s disturbances be treated?
back: As estimates only, given as a range or attributed to a source such as the 1997 Commission report (about 20,000); they are disputed.

front: What were the benefits and limits of reconciliation?
back: Benefits: stability and skills kept. Limits: land and war grievances left partly unaddressed.
